user.title: Ropam Neo panel
user.description: Local connection data (same as the RopamNeo app). Mobile app access must be enabled in the panel.

data_description.host: Local IP of the panel (reserve it in your router).
data_description.device_id: 16-character ID from NeoGSM-IP Manager (or the RopamNeo app QR code).
data_description.tcp_key: Application encryption key from the Manager communication tab.
data_description.user_code: User code with app permission. Used to log in and to arm/disarm.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the panel (IP/port, network).
error.busy: Panel busy - another connection is active.
error.bad_dialog: Unexpected response - check the panel ID.
error.no_permission: The user has no app permission.
error.login_locked: Login locked by the panel (too many attempts). Wait.
error.unknown: Unexpected error - see the Ropam Neo tab.
